newsitem.title: USA: UDS conducts minor repairs on Calif. plant.
newsitem.headline: UDS conducts minor repairs on Calif. plant.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp Thursday conducted minor repairs on its refinery near Los Angeles, but said gasoline production would remain close to normal, a company spokeswoman said.
Traders said an abnormal number of flares were discharging at the plant early Thursday, making them suspect a mechanical problem.
"There are some repairs going on at the refinery but it won't have any significant impact on production," said Ultramar Diamond Shamrock spokeswoman Helen Pitts.
She declined to give further details on the problem or nature of repairs.
The flares did not threaten public safety or health, she said.
The plant, located south of Los Angeles in Wilmington, Calif., produces about 100,000 barrels-per-day of gasoline and distillates, which include jet and diesel fuels.
